title: Tamed Mount: Owl
text: Mount Grand Grand Ferocious Owl Quiet wings and sharp eyes, this owl drops on foes before they look up. The Tamed Owl has the following skills: Lv10: Run!Run!Instant30sec CooldownIncreases Move Speed +80%, then gradually decreases it over 10sec. Can't be used while carrying a trade pack. Lv20: Wild ChargeWild ChargeInstant30sec CooldownCharges forward for 3sec, breaking through enemy lines. Inflicts Knockback and Trip on affected enemies. This skill counts as a Push effect. Can't be used while carrying a trade pack. Lv30: BlindBlindInstant24sec CooldownCharges at a faraway target, inflicting Blind for 3sec and decreasing the Accuracy for Physical Attacks -70% of affected enemies for 3sec. Can't be used while carrying a trade pack. or OverwhelmOverwhelmInstant10sec Cooldown[Pet Skill] Overwhelm Lv40: Body SlamBody SlamInstant24sec CooldownPounces at and stuns a faraway target for (varies). Can't use while carrying a trade pack. or SlamSlamInstant15sec CooldownStrikes an enemy with a strong blow, dealing (varies) Physical Damage and inflicting Stun for 1sec. Right-click to activate auto-use. Lv50: Eye ContactEye ContactInstant45sec CooldownInflicts Fear to enemies within a 4m radius for 2 seconds. Can't be used while under the effect of Run! or Wild Charge. or Vicious BiteVicious BiteInstant18sec CooldownStrikes a distant target, dealing (varies) Physical Damage and an additional (varies) damage over 14sec. Can't be used while charging, airborne, or carrying a trade pack. Use: Summons a mount.
